title: Mini Crate

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Used to transport items without the worry of items falling out

body:
"Crates can be used to store loose items and move them over long distances without accidently spilling them, this variant can hold a total of 2x4. Anchoring the crate will anchor everything inside of the crate automatically."

Description

The Mini Crate costs $250 and can be found inside of The Oak Depot. When used, it'll allow you to carry items across the map without the worry of dropping items. It's the smallest crate in the game.
